central_theme: Amphibian life cycle, biological adaptation, and environmental harmony

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Understanding nature through the biological metamorphosis of amphibians.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Every living creature plays a vital role in ecological balance and pest control.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Respecting aquatic habitats, observing growth stages, and nature appreciation.

child_nodes.title: Stage 1: Eggs & Tadpole
child_nodes.details: Eggs hatch into aquatic tadpoles breathing through gills and swimming with tails.

child_nodes.title: Stage 2: Metamorphosis
child_nodes.details: Tadpoles grow hind legs, then forelegs, and gradually absorb their tail.

child_nodes.title: Stage 3: Adult Frog
child_nodes.details: Adult frog develops lungs and webbed feet, living comfortably on land and water.

child_nodes.title: The Frog
child_nodes.details: Versatile amphibian with moist skin, sticky tongue, and powerful hind legs.

child_nodes.title: Tadpole
child_nodes.details: Water-dwelling larval form that demonstrates biological growth stages.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Webbed feet, amphibian, tadpole, metamorphosis, habitat, predator, gills, damp.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: 'ph' sounding like '/f/' in 'amphibian'; short vowel /ɛ/ in 'webbed'.

child_nodes.title: Present Continuous Tense
child_nodes.details: Describing ongoing processes: 'is growing legs', 'is swimming'.

child_nodes.title: Cause and Effect Structures
child_nodes.details: Because frogs have webbed feet, they swim fast in water.

child_nodes.title: Aquatic Wildlife Fact
child_nodes.details: Ganges River Dolphin recognized as India's national aquatic animal.
